gaps.summary: Native generation checkpoint/tail recovery and disk-backed permanent command lookup are implemented with lineage-sealed active tails and explicit downgrade export.
gaps.disposition: CLOSED. Canonical native startup consumes a digest-bound selected generation, bounded hot replay and the lineage-bound active tail instead of repopulating all historical commands into the coordinator. Simulator economic-state restoration separately replays the verified complete logical generation chain so terminal fills, admission count and order-id watermark are not lost at rotation; installed-process acceptance exercises fill, stop, V2 seal, restart, position, command identity, duplicate no-resend and newer order-id behavior. Historical `(agent, session, command)` identity and canonical request hashes remain in pinned cumulative disk indexes used by status/admission lookup. Current V2 send-attempt indexes are globally ordered by account/domain/time and use stream merge; a legacy unsorted parent is migrated with bounded external-sort chunks rather than whole-file materialization. Verification streams cumulative indexes and parent-chain walking has no fixed 1024-generation ceiling while cycles still fail closed. V2 stopped-state maintenance fsyncs immutable delta generations, atomically rotates the active path to a non-JSON lineage sentinel, binds parent manifests and current pointers by SHA-256, and preserves V1 reading for upgrade. No command identity is expired, no journal history is deleted, and PAPER/LIVE authorization remains false.

gaps.summary: Ruleset 22597364 still enforces two approvals, code-owner review and merge queue despite owner-operated intent.
gaps.disposition: OPEN. The read-only transition planner preserves the actual required checks, deletion and force-push protection. The available GitHub integration exposes Ruleset readback but no administrative Ruleset write action; no alternate administration plugin is connected. Server administration and post-change readback therefore remain a real owner action and are not represented as a source-code closure.

gaps.summary: Detailed per-reason/reconnect telemetry and target-host observation remain incomplete; callback, quote/snapshot age, Broker reconciliation and exact network-policy source producers are implemented.
gaps.disposition: OPEN. Coordinator lock wait/operation timing and 41 fixed local reason bins remain implemented. IB PAPER emits one lock-bound authoritative recovery-audit observation containing connection/event-stream state, active/terminal/risk generations and completeness, exposure/post-fill reconciliation and terminal-drain state. The installed reporter now derives three fixed-cardinality continuous observed-duration lower bounds from recent samples: post-fill reconciliation pending, authoritative snapshot incompleteness and terminal callback drain pending; service/connection epoch changes and monotonic-clock regression reset those durations rather than manufacturing continuity. The `ib-paper` telemetry profile independently parses and atomically publishes OMS, IB and Gateway textfiles; invalid IB input replaces only IB health with explicit collector failure while valid OMS/Gateway publication continues. Callback ingress-to-routing lag/conflict, quote/snapshot age and successful post-fill Broker reconciliation duration are native source producers. `hepta_broker_egress_policy.py --observe-json` separately performs exact host-owned nftables readback and recognizes only canonical allow or compiled deny-all; the unprivileged IB daemon intentionally does not claim that privileged observation. Complete upstream per-reason lifecycle, reconnect/refresh duration and portfolio notional/PnL/drawdown remain open. No target-host SLO, policy-observer activation or real notification is proven.

gaps.summary: Actual target-host multiday stability, failure collection and delivery to the real operator remain unverified.
gaps.disposition: Split from the external operations portion of OMS-LIFECYCLE-002 without claiming completion. Disposable PID1, multi-UID process fixtures and loopback monitoring are independent source evidence, not an activated target-host collector or a real receiver. The source-side IB state stream has bounded collection and atomic publication, but the actual target host still has to run it, retain failure evidence and deliver an alert through an approved operator receiver. No host, credential, network policy or trading authority was changed.
